Alex G: Heads up — after swapping to kernel v3 in prod we see a p99 spike on the streaming chat service (svc-chat) but non-streaming completions look fine. Anyone else seeing this?
Maria P: Yep, noticed during the morning ramp. p50 ~= baseline, p95 up ~10ms, p99 up ~120ms vs v2. Only reproducible when microbatch size >= 8 for streaming.
Cheng L: I ran a quick trace. Correlation looks like KV-cache misses + an alternate kernel path that triggers for certain sequence lengths. Also some head-of-line blocking from shared microbatch pool across sessions.
Maria P: Heap snapshot + perf sample:
```
GPU kernel stats:
 kernel_A (short-path)  avg 12ms 90%
 kernel_B (long-path)   tail 150-300ms spikes
 KV_cache_miss_rate      went from 4% -> 12% under burst
```
infra-bot: deploybot: rolled kernel v2 -> v3 at 2026-02-18T11:03:00Z (canary -> prod)
Maria P: Proposed mitigation: separate microbatch configs by workload. streaming_chat: max_microbatch=4; non_streaming_completions: max_microbatch=16. Also consider disabling cross-session continuous-batching for streaming.
Alex G: Can we gate this behind a runtime flag and collect metrics? Need tags: microbatch_size, kv_cache_hit, kernel_variant, tail_latency.
Cheng L: Opened a quick PR with a streaming_profile param (max_mb=4, batch_watermark_ms=50) — link: https://github.internal/redwood/runtime/PR/1234 (canary-ready).
perf-bot: perf test summary for PR1234 (canary): streaming p99 420ms -> 220ms (-47%), p95 ~ -12ms, throughput for streaming -8%. Non-streaming completions: no measurable regression within noise.
Maria P: Tradeoff seems acceptable given tail reduction. Need to ensure completions throughput and cost remain stable. Early numbers show <2% cost delta.
Alex G: Rollout plan: 1) Canary 5% traffic with the new streaming_profile, 2) Emit p50/p95/p99 + KV hit rate + kernel_variant per-route, 3) Re-eval after 48h. Cheng owns rollout, Maria owns dashboards.
Cheng L: Will do. Note: kernel v3 changed KV layout which increases eviction churn for long-lived sessions — watching eviction_counters.
Alex G: If eviction churn persists, fallback plan: add kernel selection heuristic: if seq_len > 2048 OR kv_eviction_rate > 5% -> use kernel_v2 for that request.
Maria P: Also add an alert: streaming p99 > 350ms sustained for 5m -> auto rollback.
infra-bot: jobs/rollout/1759632200 started (canary 5%).
Cheng L: Initial canary metrics: GPU mem +1.6%, KV_hit improved slightly after microbatch change. p99 trending down.
Maria P: FYI I tested changing streaming flush interval to 100ms — that reduced p99 but introduced jitter for interactive UX. Leaving flush at 50ms for now.
Alex G: Good. Let's monitor ~48h and reconvene. Ping me immediately if p99 spikes or KV eviction > threshold. Thanks. Closing thread.
